title: NBA JAM / ORIGINAL FOUR-PLAYER STYLE
variant: 1993 Midway four-player upright: basketball-textured NBA logo sides, black molding and blue/red court deck
preview_note: 48 x 56 px | four players / three action buttons each / NBA side logos / black trim / real tip-off capture

cabinet.purpose: Photograph of the basketball-textured dedicated-style four-player cabinet. Supplies side branding, bezel/placement and fascia; shape and original-design kit corroborated by the 1993 Midway flyer. Restoration status unverified.
cabinet.rights: Third-party photograph: photographer/license unverified. Underlying Midway/NBA artwork and trademarks retained; archive hosting is not publisher authorization or redistribution permission.

controls.purpose: Blue/red four-station court overlay. Two blue and two red joysticks; red Shoot/Block, blue Pass/Steal, white Turbo, and four photographed red Start buttons. NBA Jam Session branding also appears on the cabinet in the 1993 original Midway flyer, not Tournament Edition or another game's panel.
controls.rights: Third-party panel photograph, photographer/license and original-versus-reproduction print unverified. Underlying Midway/NBA artwork retained; no redistribution permission inferred.

marquee.purpose: Archive preview of the NBA Jam marquee PSD, original-design branding corroborated by the Midway flyer; scan versus redrawn/restoration artwork unverified. Fantasy/Tournament Edition side-art results were not used.
marquee.rights: Underlying Midway/NBA copyright and trademarks retained. PSD preview is third-party hosted; author/license and redistribution rights unverified, not a publisher-hosted master.

flyer.purpose: Corroborating 1993 Midway sales flyer carrying manufacturer/copyright credits, showing the same orange basketball sides, NBA badge, four-station blue/red court and NBA Jam Session fascia. Not used to invent unseen artwork.
flyer.rights: Printed flyer credits Midway Manufacturing Company, NBA/NBA Properties and depicted athletes. Third-party scan, scanner/redistribution license unverified; not publisher authentication or permission.

screen.purpose: Actual NBA Jam tip-off/tutorial captured from the user's nbajam.zip (revision 3.01) with the existing pinned Midway WASM core. Startup state generated with 2 coins; capture_screen.mjs --confirm=12 --action=2 --frames=600. Native 400x254; no replacement game or synthetic screen. In-game MK II advertising is part of NBA Jam's real court.
screen.rights: Game imagery Midway/NBA and depicted players; captured from a supplied local ROM. No redistribution license inferred, and no ROM included with art sources.

uncertainties: One photographed NBA side print is reused on the opposite side with readable branding. The opposite-side original print is not independently documented; black page margins/cut-outs are replaced with matching orange.
The silhouette is a low-resolution four-player upright interpretation using the existing wide shell, not a dimensionally exact factory model.

Twelve action buttons are modeled. Four Start buttons remain in the photographed overlay rather than additional raised geometry. The pictured two-slot coin door does not alter the core's four logical coin/controller ports.
Publisher-hosted artwork masters were not found; copyrighted archive photographs/scans and uncertain restoration artwork are not deployment permission.

The startup state uses 2 coins for one playable quarter. The generic 9-coin startup leaves this revision asking USE UP REMAINING CREDITS during selection; it is not used. Additional seated players can insert coins with the existing controls.
